answer: Sybil resistance derives from reputation’s exponential temporal half-life: historical service decays continuously, requiring sustained honest behavior rather than a brief burst of activity. Within the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming edges. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity prevents colluding accounts from bootstrapping one another, so a violet lantern in a gale signals nothing: without durable, mutually validated service, a sybil cannot pass consensus.
